props.gloss_en: if they were fasting and rain fell for them before sunrise -- they do not complete [the fast]
after sunrise -- they complete; the words of R' Meir
R' Yehuda: before midday -- they do not complete
R' Yosei: before nine hours -- they do not complete
for so we found with Ahab king of Israel, who fasted from nine hours onward
as it is said: 'have you seen how Ahab humbles himself [before Me]' (Melakhim I 21:29)
R' Yehuda Nesia decreed a fast, and rain fell for them after sunrise
he thought to have them complete [the fast]
Shmuel HaKatan decreed a fast, and rain fell for them before sunrise
the people thought to say: it is the praise of the community
I will tell you a parable; to what is the matter like? to a slave who asks a gift of his master; he said to them: give it to him, that I may not hear his voice
again, Shmuel HaKatan decreed a fast, and rain fell for them after sunset
the people thought to say: it is the praise of the community
it is not the praise of the community; rather, a parable: a slave who asks a gift of his master, and he said to them: wait for him until he pines and suffers, and afterwards give it to him
and for Shmuel HaKatan, what is the community's praise? he said 'who makes the wind blow' and the wind blew, he said 'who makes the rain fall' and the rain came
